أنكشف (form VII)
# أَنْكَشِفُ (ʔankašifu) /ʔan.ka.ʃi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
# أَنْكَشِفَ (ʔankašifa) /ʔan.ka.ʃi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
# أَنْكَشِفْ (ʔankašif) /ʔan.ka.ʃif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
